structured_output.mechanisms: Time is a fixed overhead (prepare, whitening, proxy selection, eval) plus epochs times conv FLOPs (stage widths and spatial sizes), discounted by the low-resolution phases, plus a small per-step cost and a Muon overhead. Accuracy rises with epochs and capacity (log FLOPs). It falls with low-res phases, cutout, random flip, and very large or zero label smoothing. It rises with light translate and with Muon.
